* rewrite environment intro fingerprint in system prompts ([c115cb9](https://github.com/cemalturkcan/opencode-anthropic-login-via-cli/commit/c115cb9152f92c09c250c287294193150b401102)), closes [ex-machina-co/opencode-anthropic-auth#118](https://github.com/ex-machina-co/opencode-anthropic-auth/issues/118) [#27](https://github.com/cemalturkcan/opencode-anthropic-login-via-cli/issues/27)
